title: Xianyu AI Service Sold Nearly 10 Million Orders in Half a Year: Sellers from Fourth-Tier Cities Are the Most, Women Account for 60%
excerpt: Xianyu released data for the first half of 2026, revealing that AI services have become the hottest category of consumption on this secondhand trading platform.
content_html:
Xianyu released data for the first half of 2026, revealing that AI services have become the hottest category of consumption on this secondhand trading platform. Data shows that the platform's AI service orders reached 9.816 million in the first half of the year, an increase of 157% compared to the previous year. Nearly 5 million users purchased AI services on Xianyu, an increase of 98% year-on-year.

AI is moving from the technology circle into the daily transaction lists of ordinary people, and the seller ecosystem on Xianyu is unexpectedly diverse. Looking at order categories, AI skill orders are the largest category, accounting for 45.1% of all AI orders; AI tutorial and course orders account for 8.1%, and AI template and workflow orders account for 6.6%, covering professional services such as workflow customization and AI intelligent agent setup.

AI programming increased 17 times, and manga tutorials sold 17,000 copies in half a year

The fastest growing categories are impressive. AI programming and website building orders increased by 1732%, with some users using AI tools to complete code writing and website building. AI manga orders increased by 1425%, and AI PPT and office-related orders increased by 264%. One seller sold 17,000 copies of an AI manga production tutorial in just half a year.

In terms of seller profiles, people aged 18 to 35 make up more than 60%, and female sellers account for 62.4%. The average monthly transaction volume is 897 yuan, mostly as a side job. From a geographical perspective, sellers from fourth-tier cities account for the highest percentage at 32.2%, followed by second-tier cities at 28.6%; on the buyer side, second-tier city users lead with 30.6%, closely followed by fourth-tier cities with 26.1%.

When AI programming courses and manga tutorials are selling well in fourth-tier cities, this signal may be more indicative than any industry report — AI's popularization is not just a slogan. It is permeating into the most real microvasculature through secondhand trading platforms.

content_html_zh:
闲鱼发布2026年上半年数据显示，人工智能服务已成为二手交易平台最热门的消费品类。 数据显示，上半年该平台AI服务订单量达981.6万笔，较上年增长157%。 近500万用户在闲鱼上购买AI服务，同比增长98%。

人工智能正在从科技圈走进普通人的日常交易清单，闲鱼上的卖家生态系统出乎意料地多元化。 从订单类别来看，AI技能订单是最大类别，占全部AI订单的45.1%； AI教程及课程订单占比8.1%，AI模板及工作流程订单占比6.6%，涵盖工作流程定制、AI智能坐席设置等专业服务。

AI编程增长17倍，漫画教程半年销量17000份

增长最快的类别令人印象深刻。 AI编程和建站订单增长1732%，部分用户使用AI工具完成代码编写和建站。 AI漫画订单增长1425%，AI PPT及办公相关订单增长264%。 一位卖家仅半年就卖出了17000份AI漫画制作教程。

从卖家群体来看，18岁至35岁人群占比超过60%，其中女性卖家占比62.4%。 月均交易额897元，多为副业。 从地域来看，四线城市卖家占比最高，为32.2%，二线城市次之，为28.6%；买家方面，二线城市用户以30.6%领先，四线城市紧随其后，占比26.1%。

当AI编程课程和漫画教程在四线城市热销时，这个信号可能比任何行业报告都更具指示性——AI的普及不仅仅是一个口号。 它正在通过二手交易平台渗透到最真实的微血管中。
